title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Five-scene monumental Spaces engine
preserve: true Euclidean 3D camera-center lighting on world geometry
Map 5 orange ritual avenue and straight longitudinal road lines

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v22 applies the accumulated floor/motion/Map 5 feedback: Map 1 floor no longer exposes horizontal Z-band seams; Map 4 tunnel is anchored to fixed world segments with moving ribs and a real world-space end wall for optical flow; Map 5 uses a continuous lateral floor, preserves straight longitudinal road stripes, alternates left/right spires instead of pairing them, and enlarges the hinged cardboard signs into screen-like panels.

open_feedback: Review Map 1 floor: it should read as one continuous surface with no visible transverse renderer seams.
Review Map 4 movement: advancing/backing should visibly move ribs, wall segmentation and the world-space end wall.
Review Map 5 large sign scale: signs should feel like big user-facing screens without obscuring the entire avenue.
Review Map 5 one-and-one rhythm: left/right spires must alternate instead of appearing opposite each other.
Review Map 5 floor: central lines stay straight/longitudinal while lateral ground shows no horizontal band seams.
